headline: Institutional Investors Net Buy NT$29.2 Billion; Foreign Investors Favor Actively Managed ETFs | Securities
summary: Taiwan stocks closed at 48,353.49, up 413.36 points, on trading value of NT$837.4 billion. Institutional groups net bought NT$29.3 billion, with foreign investors buying for two days and ETFs leading.
why: The TAIEX is Taiwan's main equity benchmark, and its heavyweight listed companies are central to global electronics and chip supply chains. Institutional and foreign flows shape its daily moves.
why_moved: Taiwan stocks gained 413 points as the three major institutional investor groups net bought NT$29.3 billion simultaneously. Foreign investors net bought for a second straight session, with ETFs as the main buying force.
